quarterly_data.signal: Unimicron MOPS filing: Unimicron acquired land (19 parcels, 63,048.00 square metres, about 19,072.02 ping) and buildings (14 building units, 58,186.50 square metres, about 17,601.42 ping) at No. 1-1 Wenhua Road, Hsinchu Industrial Park, Hukou Township, Hsinchu County from Bridgestone Taiwan Co., Ltd. (not a related party) by tender; total transaction amount NT$10,088,880,000; board approval 09-08-2026, transaction date 09-30-2026. Stated purpose (company): mainly to meet customers' future high-end substrate capacity expansion needs by securing land and plant resources, in line with the company's mid- to long-term strategy for overall production allocation and capacity planning.
